action: Contact Sarah Kim directly to share what I'm observing from inside the gig delivery ecosystem about the second robotaxi competitor and autonomous delivery rollout. I've been running gig deliveries on multiple platforms — I have ground-level data on which corridors are losing orders, which platforms are quietly throttling human couriers, and what the new competitor's interface looks like from the worker side. This is real intelligence and Sarah trusts me. I send her a message today: 'Hey — saw you're asking around about the new robotaxi player. I've been running gig deliveries across all the platforms this month and watching what the autonomous launch is doing to order volume. If it's useful, I can tell you what I'm seeing on the ground. Coffee this week?'
